dedupe_keys.name: igsu romania emergency response statistics yearly interventions of the professional emergency services

description: This resource is the series of statistical datasets that Romania's General Inspectorate for Emergency Situations publishes on the national open data portal data.gov.ro, harvested into the European data portal. The inspectorate runs the professional emergency services, the county fire and rescue inspectorates, and publishes yearly spreadsheets on interventions of the professional services in emergency situations, together with earlier datasets on personnel and equipment used in response, prevention activity, half-year response statistics and an annual activity summary from 2013. The 2022 dataset, 'interventiile serviciilor profesioniste in situatii de urgenta', was published in January 2024 as an Excel file. Coverage is national. Files are free downloads; the licence is not shown on the European portal record. Caveats: file layouts change between years, spreadsheets are in Romanian, the most recent years may be missing, and data.gov.ro was not reachable from the cloud session, so the full list of years was read from the European portal. Simulation uses: annual demand baselines for fire, rescue and emergency medical response in Romania, comparing intervention types over time, and calibrating national emergency service capacity models. Related records: the Moldovan IGSU emergency statistics (data-igsu-moldova-emergency-statistics) cover the neighbouring country and EM-DAT (data-em-dat) records major disasters.
